title: VDN-H3: record the mechanics, and test whether the retention knobs raise its resolution ceiling
description: VDN-H3 (OpenVDN/vdn-minimax-h3 + Saganaki22/ComfyUI-VDN-H3) evaluated on the bench 2026-09-06. Two halves. (1) Record what was learned about how the node behaves on a pruned base - the three lora_mode configs, the e-grid correction, the S-to-canvas mapping, the retention knobs and the OOM ceiling - in docs/models/h3/vdn.md, so it is not re-derived. (2) Open experiment: VDN OOM'd on the windowed refine at 1920x1088 (S=2040) by only 557 MiB while holding 2.15 GiB of retained buffers plus branch weights on the GPU (branch_weights=auto chose cache_gpu, retain_buffers=auto chose retained). Forcing branch_weights=stream + retain_buffers=off may put that canvas back inside VDN's range and move the tier threshold. Blocked on the ship/no-ship call - if VDN is dropped, this closes as rejected.
